_comment: decision=required means the feature needs a real user policy choice and is raised at session start after an upgrade. decision=none means it ships silently with a sensible default: no prompt, still documented, still settable via its env key. Most features should be 'none'. A prompt is for a genuine fork in behaviour or cost, not for announcing that work happened.

features.title: Claude Fable 5.1 routing
features.question: How should Claude Fable 5.1 be used?

choices.label: Not at all
choices.description: Opus 5 stays the lead for everything. No added cost. Changeable later with /octo:whats-new.

choices.label: Planning and PRDs
choices.description: Fable 5.1 authors PRDs, definition tradeoffs and cross-vendor tie-breaks. $10/$50 per MTok, twice Opus 5, capped at one dispatch per command.

choices.label: Planning, PRDs and reviews
choices.description: As above, plus plan and spec review. Fable 5.1 is Anthropic-family like Opus 5, so a Fable review of Opus work is not an independent cross-vendor check.

choices.label: Only when I ask
choices.description: Never automatic. Available by pinning OCTOPUS_OPUS_MODEL=claude-fable-5-1 for a session.

features.title: Who reviews Codex-written code
features.question: When Codex writes the code, who should review it?

choices.label: A Claude seat
choices.description: Review moves to Opus 5 so author and reviewer are different vendors. Costs Opus 5 rates for the review step.

choices.label: Keep Codex reviewing
choices.description: Current behaviour. Cheaper, but Codex reviews its own output, which catches less.

features.title: Proactive provider health probe
features.description: Validates API-key providers at preflight instead of discovering a dead key mid-workflow. Set OCTOPUS_PREFLIGHT_PROBE=1 to enable.
